tabs.html:
Otech TZE-221 ( 9mm X 8M) Laminated Black on White Tape Cartridge

 The Otech TZE-221 is a 9mm x 8-meter laminated label tape cartridge with black text on a white background. Designed for long-lasting performance, it is resistant to water, fading, abrasion, and harsh temperatures, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. This tape is ideal for clear, professional labeling in offices, homes, warehouses, and industrial environments.


Key Features:

  • Tape size: 9mm x 8M
  • Color: Black text on White background
  • Laminated for durability
  • Water, fade, and abrasion resistant
  • Easy to peel and apply

Compatible with Brother P-touch label printers that use TZe tapes 

Works with all P-Touch label makers that print on 9mm TZe label tape
